newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' 91-day T-bill rate at 10.529 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' 91-day T-bill rate at 10.529 pct.

text.p: The Philippines' bellwether 91-day Treasury bill rate fell to 10.529 percent compared with last week's 10.892 percent, the Bureau of Treasury said on Monday.
The auction committee accepted 1.5 billion pesos out of the 7.7 billion tendered.
The 182-day average rate fell to 10.887 percent from last week's 11.348 percent with 1.5 billion pesos awarded out of 13.37 billion tendered.
The 364-day average was also lower at 11.375 percent, compared to 11.809 percent last week. The committee accepted 2.0 billion pesos from the total tendered amount of 13.05 billion.
